backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing user profiles, access control, and habit tracking with completion state and optional volume tracking.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report describing a frontend requirement to preserve accurate time-based volume display for specific habits.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-written summaries of multiple frontend files covering habit features, components, styling, and behavior.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind-based theme variables and base styles including light/dark color tokens and layout defaults.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading the main module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring React Query, rendering the app layout, auth controls, main view, and footer.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthRequire: Alert prompting unauthenticated users to sign in, with explanatory text and a login button.
frontend/src/components/auth/AuthStateIn: Badge component showing whether the user is signed in based on Internet Identity state.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button handling Internet Identity login/logout flows with state-aware labeling and styling.
frontend/src/features/becoming/api/queri: React Query hooks for loading and mutating habit data with actor-aware error handling and identity-scoped keys.
frontend/src/features/becoming/component: Main habit view handling auth gating, error and loading states, and rendering the habit grid by month.
Destructive alert displaying user-friendly error messages with an optional retry action.
Renders skeleton placeholders for the habit grid layout, including month tabs, header, and habit rows.
Provides a modal for editing habit name, unit type, and volume with validation and update mutations.
Displays the habit grid with day headers and rows for each habit, handling empty states.
Defines shared layout constants and helpers for aligning habit grid columns.
Allows users to add a new habit through an inline input UI with add/cancel actions.
Renders a single habit row with info, daily completion checkboxes, and edit/actions controls.
Popover that exposes actions for a habit row, currently supporting editing.
Renders tab controls for selecting a month based on the 2026 calendar.
frontend/src/features/becoming/constants: Contains month metadata for 2026 and helpers to retrieve month info and day counts.
frontend/src/features/becoming/state/hab: Transforms habit data into completion maps and provides utilities for completion, unit, and volume calculations.
frontend/src/features/becoming/utils/tim: Provides validation, parsing, normalization, and formatting utilities for time strings in M or M:SS formats.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useActorWithTimeout.t: Initializes a backend actor with a 15s timeout, error normalization, manual retry, and query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity context and provider handling login, logout, stored identities, and status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based global styles and a light cyber‑themed design with utility classes and mobile touch optimizations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app by setting up React Query and the Internet Identity provider before rendering App.
frontend/src/utils/icErrors.ts: Normalizes errors and detects stopped‑canister cases, producing safer user‑friendly error messages.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, including session-backed storage and hash handling.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config enabling dark mode, custom colors, typography, container queries, animations, and extended theme settings.
project_state.json: Project state describing habit progression rules, including new feature requests for Plank monthly increases, fixed Squash values, and time unit initialization fixes.
